newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's June oil output down 6.7 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's June oil output down 6.7 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Ecuador produced an average of 356,528 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in June 1997, down 6.7 percent from the same month last year, an official said Friday.
The official from Petroleum National Direction, who asked not to be identified, said average output in the first six months was 382,736 bpd.
A comparative figure was not available.
In June 1996, Ecuador produced an average of 382,496 bpd.
"There was a change in the operation of Coca and Payamino amazonic fields, which were developed before by Oryx and now are operated by Petroproduccion", said the official.
Oil production in Ecuador was an average of 383,858 bpd last year.
Meanwhile, Ecuador exported 6.85 million barrels of crude oil in June, up from the 6.13 million shipped during the same month last year, the state oil firm Petroecuador said.
((--Gustavo Oviedo, Quito Newsroom, 5932 258429 x114, e-mail: reuters1@reutersecu.com.ec))
